content.short: AVNU is a liquidity infrastructure providing the best on-chain execution for traders and dapps.
content.description: AVNU is a decentralized exchange protocol designed to offer the best execution. It enables traders to swap assets in a trustless, fast, and secure way on Ethereum and ZK-rollups, while delivering broad cross-chain access. The protocol coordinates on-chain liquidity and efficient settlement across multiple networks, helping users trade smarter, with lower frictions and stronger assurances of security. Supported chains include Starknet, Ethereum, ZKsync, Solana, Polygon, and Multichain, reflecting a versatile, multi-chain DeFi experience.
